text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run linting
        run: yarn lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: yarn test

      - name: Build project
        run: yarn build

      - name: Upload test results to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: coverage
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is designed to replace the removed E2E devbox infrastructure and ensure that the CI pipeline runs the necessary tests and builds. It includes steps for checking out the code, setting up Node.js, installing dependencies, running linting, executing tests, building the project, and uploading test results to Codecov. The workflow triggers on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.
